scripts.//build:mcp: `wrangler deploy --dry-run` bundles the Worker without deploying and without credentials. It is a separate script from `build` because it catches what tsc cannot: an import with no Workers implementation resolves fine for the typechecker and fails at bundle time.
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/db typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/mcp typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/desktop typecheck
scripts.gate: bun run build && bun run build:mcp && bun run lint && bun run typecheck
